title: Cliché Finder
description: Scan your writing for overused clichés against a built-in list of 90+ phrases — each hit is highlighted and counted.
howto: Paste your article, essay or story into the box.
Every cliché from the built-in list is highlighted in your text.
Review the found list with counts, then rewrite the flagged phrases in your own words.

faqs.q: How many clichés does it check?
faqs.a: The tool checks your text against a built-in list of 90+ common English clichés, from "think outside the box" to "the whole nine yards".
No. Matching ignores case and works on whole phrases, so "At The End Of The Day" is found just like the lowercase form.
Clichés make writing feel stale and generic. Replacing them with specific, original phrasing makes your work more vivid and credible.
